direction.signature: One picture, two engines: a baked cutout SVG (0 requests) is the GL map's poster; same Web Mercator projection, measured 0.000 px drift, so the live map fades in without moving.

compositions.map-first: map 960 wide with a 320 status rail (picked)
compositions.legend-overlay: full-bleed map with a floating legend card (rejected: covers the coast on phones)
compositions.list-first: ledger list with a small locator map (rejected: hides the shoreline signature)

looks.cutout: baked SVG from OpenFreeMap/OSM tiles + Census TIGER counties

decisions: MARC county outlines move to Census TIGER (public domain); the app's simplified counties.geojson clashes with the baked river
GL pins become a symbol layer so labels collide with them
